title: Minimum gamma energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the minimum gamma-ray energy required for the reaction, which is 913 MeV.

title: Fermi motion adjustment
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately compute the adjusted minimum photon energy considering Fermi motion, which is 739 MeV.

title: Momentum conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of energy and momentum principles correctly to find the maximum momentum of the pion in the laboratory frame.

title: Transverse momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the maximum component of the pion's momentum perpendicular to the direction of the Lambda^0, which is 101 MeV/c.

title: Sign errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy-momentum equations, which can lead to incorrect final answers.
